signals.evidence_quote: Drawing on flood modelling and mapping alongside exploratory surveys and discussions with 98 households in Kibera, Mukuru Viwandani and Mathare, the issue brief examines factors driving flood risk in Nairobi city — with a special focus on informal settlements and the associated ... using the 2024 floods as the case study.
